title: d1-3B decide
description: Pinned LiquidAI System One on text/JSON and optional local images.

state.description: Text/JSON state; null for images alone.

questions.description: Question name → question. Names come back as the answers' keys; they are not shown to the model.

model.description: d1-3b; omit on this model’s operation endpoint.

bits.description: Required precision; 0 accepts the loaded dtype, 16 matches bf16 and 8 matches int8; 4 matches int4. A mismatch returns 409 without changing the loaded dtype.

merge.description: The vendor shared-state decision tree is always used.

path.description: Existing absolute local image path; MCP paths must be in Arsenal jobs/inbox.

question.description: A typed question about the state. Unknown fields are ignored.

type.description: noul = yes/no (answer P(yes)); choice = one of named options; score = an ordered level.

instructions.description: The question, as text or structured JSON. Optional.

criteria.description: noul: optional {"true", "false"}; choice: options; score: levels, lowest first.

true.description: What the option means: text, structured JSON, or null for the bare option.

false.description: What the option means: text, structured JSON, or null for the bare option.

additionalProperties.description: What the option means: text, structured JSON, or null for the bare option.

criteria.description: Option label → description (null for the bare label). Labels are compared as exact strings.

items.description: What the option means: text, structured JSON, or null for the bare option.

criteria.description: Level descriptions, lowest first; levels are answered as "0", "1", …
